name: Tehodoki Koukan ~Boku no ga ○○ ga ×× de Tomaranai yo...~
original_name: てほどき交感～ボクのが○○が××で止まらないよ…～
source: Honjou Takuma is a fairly ordinary young man whose life gets complicated when he becomes involved with Minami, his best friend’s mother, and then with Sayuri, his own stepmother. What starts as temptation turns into a secretive love triangle, and he soon has to figure out how to handle the situation.
